The audio clip features a single male speaker discussing a previous video and describing a two-stage process. He mentions that the first stage involves knowing "at what point the contact is lost." He notes that two relations between "u versus mg and theta" and "u versus g and again theta" will be used for further calculations.

The audio clip begins with a male speaker instructing to move to stage two, where something has lost contact. He explains that the person has seen a cycloidal path after losing contact with respect to the ground frame. He suggests a method to convert the cycloidal path to a circular path by ensuring that the gravitational field is canceled. This involves moving with respect to a frame in a rightward direction at a velocity such that the particle's MG vector in the downward direction is canceled by a QE field vector generated due to the motion of the frame. He reminds the listener that in the actual ground frame, there is no electric field but the transformed electric field can be found. The speaker goes on to explain how to choose the velocity so that the value of the transformed field force in the upward direction cancels the MG. He asks what happens next.
